name: Our Kingdom Spa and Massage

reviews.text: I had a terrible knot in my shoulder for the last few days. It was getting worse every morning, so I knew I needed help. I made an appointment in the morning for later that day. They were able to accommodate short notice and gave me one the best massages I’ve ever had. I asked for deep pressure and Ellen did not disappoint. The first 15-20 minutes were focused on my shoulders and neck and pretty intense, but I started to feel better immediately. By the end I felt like a new person. Ellen is truly gifted at her craft and I am so pleased to have found this local gem. I even bought some gift cards for my loved ones (and me 🙂). I can’t wait to go back, hopefully before I get into the state I was today.
reviews.author: Jillian Roamer

reviews.text: I was gifted a full body exfoliating sugar scrub from my son for my birthday which was in September and days afterwards I bought a house. Took me almost 80 days to get there but I'm so glad I did. I really needed to relax my mind and body. I never had an experience in a spa before so I didn't know what to expect going in. The atmosphere was actually better than I expected. The vibe was warm and welcoming. From the outside you wouldn't expect to walking in to such a view that automatically make you feel like you are going to be well taken care of. Love was assigned to do the exfoliating sugar scrub. She listened and really went to work on my sore shoulders working out the kinks and having me do breathing exercises to help me relax. If you haven't had a message, please consider giving yourself a gift and go visit this place. The only thing I was not prepared for was trying to get off as much of the residue from the sugar before I got dressed. I felt a little hurried because there was a person waiting to be serviced. Do yourself a favor and just wear a jogging suit or clothing easy to put on and take off when you go there.
reviews.author: Beryl Tillman

reviews.text: Ellen was very kind and professional. The massage was absolutely terrific. Ellen took all the knots out of my muscles and I truly felt relaxed. There was a significant noticeable difference in how I felt afterward the massage. The quality of the massage was worth well more than 5 stars.
reviews.author: Akash Parmar

reviews.text: My massage was the best I’ve ever had in my 39 years of life. She’s incredibly knowledgeable about body anatomy and expertly targeted muscles I didn’t even know existed. She truly values her customers and goes above and beyond to ensure a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Anthony Cherrylee

reviews.text: My first massage with Ellen quite literally changed my life. I am an athlete and a personal trainer, I tend to have a lot of tension/tightness in my back and hamstrings. I booked a sports massage, and Ellen did a really great job of using varying levels of pressure to address stiffness. I really appreciated that she showed attention to the front of my body (quads and biceps) as well, as I feel like they’re often missed during massages. I am already looking forward to my next service here :)
reviews.author: Asia Broadus
